title: NexRun catalog
description: The catalog document: an array of catalog entries. Exists so that catalog/catalog.json can be validated as a whole by a generic JSON Schema tool; the per-record contract lives in catalog-entry.schema.json. This file deliberately declares no $id: an absolute $id would make the sibling $ref below resolve to a network URL, and CI must never depend on a live domain to tell you your catalog is malformed.
